reason: I'm two waiters short, so anything that lets guests pay at the table without waiting for someone to bring the bill helps me right now. Three months free means I can test it without risk, and I like trying new tools.
objection: The payment partner's per-transaction fee on top of my card terminal fees, and whether my older regulars will actually scan a QR code instead of asking for the bill. The staff board is nice but I already find people on jobs.ge and Instagram.
would_change_my_mind: If the transaction fee turns out higher than my current terminal, or if guests ignore the QR in the first month, I cancel before paying.
